caveats: The first 64 read timeouts are a bounded prefix, not a random sample. Omitted failures are not classified.
The diagnostic client changes timing; do not merge these performance numbers into the decision matrix.
A fully acknowledged request establishes TCP receipt, not application dispatch or response transmission.
Cumulative retransmissions may belong to earlier exchanges. Client TCP_INFO does not expose server retransmissions.
A missing response can reflect response loss or server delay. Correlate with server-side evidence before assigning the cause.
